preconditions.description: The size of the broom n must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and 'a' <= xi <= 'z' for ui, vi, xi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and be marked with a lowercase Latin letter.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum possible size of the broom and the integer p.
The minimum size of the broom and p must be positive integers.
